title: “The Social and Political Life of a Relic: The Episode of the Moi-e-Muqaddas Theft in Kashmir, 1963–1964”
note: Article in HIMALAYA 38(2), 2018, analyzing the relic theft, protests, and political meanings.
whyItMatters: Analyses the 1963 relic theft, the protests and the political meaning of the relic in Kashmir and across the subcontinent.
